grammarFocus: 第一条件句；because / therefore；情态动词建议。
title: A Community Garden Meeting
instructions: 阅读下面的短文，然后回答问题。短文是关于一个社区花园的会议。请仔细阅读，并根据短文内容选择或填写答案。所有题目均为单选题或填空题。填空题答案必须与原文完全一致，且不超过字数限制。本材料为模拟练习，不是官方雅思试题。
passage:
Last week, the Green Street community held a meeting about a new garden. About twenty people came. The garden will be on an empty lot behind the library. The lot is old and dirty now, but people want to change it.

First, Ms. Chen spoke. She said, "We want a garden because fresh vegetables are expensive. If we grow our own food, we will save money. Also, gardening is good exercise, and children can learn about plants here." Everyone agreed. Mr. Lee said, "This is a good idea because many families in our street are poor."

Then Mr. Lee talked about water. He said, "We need water. If we don't have water, the plants will die. We should ask the city for help. Therefore, I suggest we write a letter to the city council." The group liked this idea. Ms. Chen said she could write the letter, because she writes letters at her office every day.

Next, Anna asked, "What about tools? We need shovels and gloves." Ms. Chen answered, "You should bring your own tools if you have them. If not, we can borrow some from the school. The school has many old shovels." Anna smiled and said she had two shovels at home.

Finally, they talked about work days. They decided to meet every Saturday morning, from nine to eleven. Mr. Lee said, "If it rains, we will meet in the library instead. We can plan the garden there." Everyone wrote down the plan in a small notebook.

The meeting ended at 8 p.m. People felt happy. They will start the garden next month. Ms. Chen said, "If we all work together, the garden will be beautiful."

grammar.title: 第一条件句与因果关系
grammar.explanation: 第一条件句表示将来可能发生的事：if 从句用一般现在时，主句用 will + 动词原形。例如：If it rains, we will meet in the library. 另外，because 表示原因，therefore 表示结果。情态动词 should 表示建议，例如：You should bring your own tools.
grammar.example: If it rains, we will meet in the library instead.

questions.prompt: If it ___ tomorrow, we will stay at home.
questions.explanation: 第一条件句中，if 从句用一般现在时，所以选 rains。
questions.evidence: If it rains, we will meet in the library instead.

questions.prompt: She is tired, ___ she will go to bed early.
questions.explanation: therefore 表示结果，符合句意“她累了，因此她会早睡”。
questions.evidence: Therefore, I suggest we write a letter to the city council.

questions.prompt: You ___ bring your own tools if you have them.
questions.explanation: should 表示建议，符合句意“你应该带上自己的工具”。
questions.evidence: You should bring your own tools if you have them.

questions.prompt: We want a garden ___ fresh vegetables are expensive.
questions.explanation: because 表示原因，符合句意“我们想要一个花园，因为新鲜蔬菜很贵”。
questions.evidence: We want a garden because fresh vegetables are expensive.
